objective: Stop technical push/test residue from inflating the player-facing unread notification count while preserving every immutable notification and its unread status.

roles_before.artifact: Neon notification.pushed events preserve all real and technical/test notifications, including unread state.
PWA currently counts every UNREAD item equally, so three technical push tests make the live player badge show four unread items even though only one is player-relevant progression feedback.
Technical test notifications remain visible in the list but are not distinguished from ordinary player-facing messages.
Notification acknowledgement remains user-directed and must not be automated by maintenance.
Neon/PostgreSQL remains sole mutable owner; this slice is projection-only.
Git history is sufficient; no state migration.

role_dispositions.destination: No notification is deleted, acknowledged, rewritten, or hidden from the list.
Count unread player-relevant notifications separately from conservatively classified technical test residue.
Technical test messages get an explicit ТЕХНИЧЕСКОЕ marker while remaining inspectable and acknowledgeable.
User retains control of acknowledgement; technical classification changes no action permissions.
No action endpoint write or schema/event change.

capability_probes.assertion: The current three unread push/test messages are classified technical, so the player badge reports one unread player-relevant notification plus three technical items instead of four equivalent unread messages.
The unread reward notification remains player-relevant, visible, and acknowledgeable.
Technical test notifications remain visible in the notification list with their original unread/read state.
Ordinary INFO/QUEST notifications are not classified technical merely because they are informational; classification requires a conservative explicit test/probe signature.
No technical message is acknowledged, deleted, hidden, or mutated automatically.

tests.expected: explicit test/probe cases classify technical; ordinary messages fail closed to player-relevant.
badge separates player unread and technical residue without changing ack path.

verification.base_head_diff: Adds conservative projection-only classification for explicit INFO push/test residue. Player unread count separates relevant unread from technical unread; technical items remain visible, preserve read/unread state, and keep the same acknowledgement path. No auto-ack/delete/hide/write and no gameplay semantics change.

Base-to-head review found only the declared projection/UI/test/manifest slice.
